summary: Frontend-only verification of NEW ERP 'Real Purchase History' panel on Suppliers page (additive to iteration_43-47). Confirmed backend endpoint /api/suppliers/erp-prices/{product_id} works via curl, then verified via Playwright that the panel renders correctly between SAP and Local panels, shows exact expected data for SCR415WM, graceful empty state for unknown product, and no interference with existing SAP panel / Local CRUD for regression product P27175.
critical_code_review_comments: SuppliersPage.js is 922 lines - approaching the 700-line split threshold flagged in code review guidelines; consider extracting the SAP/ERP/Local read-only panels into a sub-component for maintainability, though not urgent for this additive change.
loadErpPrices/loadSapPriceSpecs/loadAssignments correctly use productLoadRequestRef to guard against race conditions from rapid successive 'Load' clicks - good defensive pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: 1) 3-panel order (SAP -> ERP -> Local) confirmed via bounding-box y-coordinates for SCR415WM. 2) ERP panel for SCR415WM shows exact expected values: Item='M4x15 PHS Screw', Most Recent='SUAKSI HARDWARES @ ₹0.18 (2026-07-31)', Lowest Seen='S.FASTNERS @ ₹0.15 (2026-03-18)', 6-Mo Avg='₹0.18 (42 bills)' - exact match to problem statement. 3) ZZZ-NOTREAL-999 shows graceful empty message 'No billed purchase history found in the ERP for "ZZZ-NOTREAL-999"' with no error/crash; SAP panel also independently showed its own empty/loading state with no interference. 4) P27175 regression: SAP panel, ERP panel (showed real data for a different item '3/8-16 SERRATED FLANGE HEX NUT GALVANIZED, TALL'), and Local assignments table all loaded independently without any crash or blocking. 5) Note: ERP panel takes ~5-6 seconds to resolve (external Price Explorer service latency) - this is expected per the problem statement, not a bug, but flagging for future testers to allow adequate wait time before asserting on the panel state. 6) Supplier Master List search/pagination smoke-tested and still functional (2984 suppliers, pagination bar visible).
